// The site grid in WORLD coordinates (plan.md): x 0..38, y -5..28, z 0..32. The toolkit's Grid only takes y >= 0 and
// load() reads only that, so the grid stores y + YOFF internally and save() writes the file in that shifted frame.
// Parts, runParts and sockets.json all keep world coordinates.
import { Grid } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/structure.mjs";

export const SIZE = [39, 34, 33];   // x 0..38, y -5..28, z 0..32 (the file's extent, not world numbers)
export const YOFF = 5;              // world y -5 is file y 0

export class SiteGrid extends Grid {
  constructor() { super(SIZE); }
  /** World bounds: x and z as the file, y from -YOFF up to the top. */
  inBounds(x, y, z) { return x >= 0 && z >= 0 && x < SIZE[0] && z < SIZE[2] && y >= -YOFF && y < SIZE[1] - YOFF; }
  /** Write the structure file, shifted so every y is >= 0. */
  save(path) {
    const out = new Grid(SIZE, { dataVersion: this.dataVersion });
    for (const c of this) out.set(c.pos[0], c.pos[1] + YOFF, c.pos[2], c.block, c.state, c.nbt);
    return out.save(path);
  }
}

input.summary: parts/shell.mjs builds the road, kerb and sidewalk, the brick shell of all three houses (plinth, party walls, rear and end walls, quoins), dark oak floors at y8/13/18 and the lobby partitions. make.sh finishes with no refused writes and no off-palette blocks for this part. All openings are left unbuilt for later parts, except the doors and rear/end glazing, which the shell places.
left: The roof fills the gable triangles, so the attic windows (x a+5..a+7, y21..22) can't be cut. The roof part has to leave those cells open.
`sockets check` reports that the keeper can't reach A3..A6. Keeper's doors are in the partitions at z22, but the lobby stairs aren't built yet, so re-check after the stairs part.

The pier cells at z7 and z6 are unbuilt for the frontage part: x1 and x37 from y1 up (including the sidewalk cell at y1), the other pier columns from y5 up. If frontage starts end piers at y2, the sidewalk cell at y1 stays a gap.
I did not tick the fascia item in elements.md (my sed failed on macOS); the board itself is built.

The shell places no window sills or lintels on the front. It leaves the z7 lintel row and the z8 glass cells open for window_bay. The rear and end walls have glass, a sandstone lintel row and quoins, but no sills.

waste.what: Checked by eye that the street render shows walls and openings in the right places
